rows.rationale: animal_scalar(id, pedigree=...) (animal-keyword.R:85) builds a single-shared-variance (per-trait) animal-model random intercept. Its own docstring states it is 'Mathematical parallel to phylo_scalar() -- same engine path', and the file header comment (animal-keyword.R:1-22) confirms all animal_* keywords route internally to the same canonical-rewrite path as phylo_* (pure grammar sugar, A/Ainv/pedigree standing in for phylo_*'s tree/vcv). Unlike animal_unique(), animal_scalar() carries no lifecycle-deprecated badge. No existing SLOPE-ANIMAL-SCALAR-* case is defined in slopes-required-case-plan.json, so a new fit-parity case is drafted here rather than reused.

rows.rationale: animal_slope(formula) (animal-keyword.R:343) adds a per-individual random slope on a continuous covariate, with slopes correlated by the additive-genetic relatedness matrix A (random-regression / reaction-norm model). Its docstring states it is 'Mathematical parallel to phylo_slope()', consistent with the file-header API-parallel table (animal-keyword.R:17: animal_slope(formula) <-> phylo_slope). It carries no lifecycle-deprecated badge and is a distinct grammar path from animal_dep/animal_indep/animal_latent (slope-only bar form, not an intercept term). No existing SLOPE-ANIMAL-SLOPE-* case is defined in slopes-required-case-plan.json, so a new fit-parity case is drafted here.

reclassify.reason: animal_unique() (animal-keyword.R:89-96) carries an explicit lifecycle::badge("deprecated") in its own docstring: 'soft-deprecated as compatibility syntax in gllvmTMB 0.2.0. Use animal_indep() for standalone marginal diagonal animal-model terms ... use animal_latent(..., unique = TRUE) when the folded latent term itself should carry this diagonal companion.' It is a deprecated alias whose behaviour is already covered by the required_core animal_indep and animal_latent(unique=TRUE) cases (SLOPE-ANIMAL-INDEP-*, SLOPE-ANIMAL-LAT-*).
